market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have finished runners-up in multiple recent EPL seasons and possess a strong, stable squad likely to contend for top positions again. Their probability of finishing exactly 2nd is around 23%, which clearly exceeds the market-implied 17.5%.
evidence_points: Arsenal placed 2nd in 2022-23 and 2023-24, demonstrating consistent top-two finishes
Young core (Saka, Ødegaard, Saliba) continues to improve with Arteta's system
While Man City remain favorite for 1st, Arsenal are firmer than other rivals for the 2nd spot
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Premier League team strengths and recent standings
